difficulty_reason: For X -> S locally of finite type, m in Z and a locally bounded above complex F^bullet of O_X-modules whose term F^i is (m - i)-pseudo-coherent relative to S for every i, the complex F^bullet is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S. The retained proof is written: the claim follows from Cohomology, lemma complex-pseudo-coherent-modules (the absolute statement that termwise shifted pseudo-coherence bounds the complex) together with the definitions — the relative notion is, by its chart definition, the absolute one applied termwise to the Koszul-structure complexes over smooth charts, so no further argument is given by the author. Retained author proof at lines 17091-17095.
